verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own marketing describes a built-in AI assistant ('Brain²') and pre-built agents that can be delegated tasks, work autonomously, and pull context from workspace/apps, which matches the story closely. However, all evidence is vendor-sourced marketing copy with no independent or hands-on confirmation that the AI delegation actually works as described, and community feedback focuses on general product bloat/quality issues rather than the AI feature specifically.
